thread:
laura_docs: Heads up - demo hit a flaky rerank failure. Error: "rerank failed: expected vector length 1024, got 1536". Happens only when we send combined batch from sample-app. Anyone seen auth/retry cause this?

nate_sdk: can you paste the client call you're using? curious if SDK is switching models when input is an array vs single string.

laura_docs: sample-app code (ts):
```ts
const out = await rw.client.embeddings.create({ model: 'embed-1024', input: docs })
// chunked to 12 and POST to /rerank
```
It logs model=embed-1024 but rerank complains some vectors are 1536.

ivan_infra: brief theory: gateway can stitch responses from different workers if a big request fans out. If one shard hosts embed-1536 and another embed-1024 we could see mixed lengths. Shouldn't happen though.

emma_se: repro rate ~20% for batch_size >= 10. Single-doc always 1024. Also noticed the SDK retry stack in browser logs: 401 -> refresh -> reissue POST while previous response stream still trickling in. Possible dup merge.

nate_sdk: ack. Our HTTP layer retries on auth refresh but doesn't block the streaming merge/dedupe in batcher. We'll need to: 1) add dedupe by request-id/idempotency key 2) make merge logic verify homogenous model/dim before concatenating.

laura_docs: quick workaround I added to sample-app: `ensureSameDim` helper that throws early and surfaces a clearer error to users. snippet:
```js
function ensureSameDim(items, dim=1024){
  const bad = items.find(i=>i.vector.length !== dim)
  if(bad) throw new Error(`inconsistent vectors: expected ${dim}`)
}
```
blocks the crash but loses graceful fallback.

support_jay: recommends adding `Idempotency-Key` per batch. If the client resends after refresh the server can detect duplicates and avoid double-apply/partial merges. Also recommend a specific support KB note.

ivan_infra: i'll add a guard in the gateway: when assembling a multi-shard response assert all `model` fields match; if mismatch return 502 + `mixed_model_shards` for now. Will instrument.

nate_sdk: small parity snag: older Python SDK returns `vectors` array while Node uses `embedding` singular. sample-apps assume `embedding`. I'll open a PR to normalize to `embedding` and add a deprecation alias in python.

laura_docs: can we also get a clearer API error code from rerank when dims inconsistent? Right now it's thrown deep in ranker and surface as generic 400.

ivan_infra: yes, adding API code `400.7 inconsistent_embedding_dims` should be quick. Putting it in the patch.

nate_sdk: on the SDK side I'll add a small helper `sanitizeEmbeddings(resp, expectedDim)` that either normalizes or raises with helpful message. Also will ensure the HTTP layer attaches `Idempotency-Key` and stalls merges until retry fully completes.

support_jay: updated KB draft: steps to triage: 1) set DEBUG=sampleapp; 2) check per-item model field in embedding response; 3) if mixed, add idempotency and contact infra with repro id; 4) temporary workaround use `sanitizeEmbeddings` to pad/truncate.

infra-bot: incident logged: INC-2026-03-13-embed-shard-mix, severity=low, assignees=ivan_infra,nate_sdk

laura_docs: thanks all. Demo is tomorrow; i'll flip the sample-app to run ensureSameDim and feature-flag the idempotency header. Will follow up here after a run. :crossed_fingers:
